newsitem.title: UK: Currency dominates Bradford wool market.
newsitem.headline: Currency dominates Bradford wool market.

text.p: The higher pound remained the dominant factor in the Bradford wool market, together with a slight easing in Australian raw wool prices at the final sales of last week.
Brokers said this prompted a small downward adjustment in quotations for some merino tops.
They also pointed out that the sharp advance in Bradford top quotations last week stifled some good enquiries that were emerging.
But the strength of New Zealand wool at auction last week has prompted some upward adjustment to English top prices ahead of Wednesday's British wool sale.
Nevertheless, exchange rate movements were widely regarded as the most serious issue currently facing the UK wool trade.
The exceptionally strong pound made it very difficult for all firms involved in exports, and those attempting to sell Merino tops into Europe were having a particularly tough time, brokers said.
